statement: The ordered nitroglycerin infusion is contraindicated and highly dangerous because the patient took sildenafil (Viagra) recently, which can cause life-threatening hypotension.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states "the ordered nitroglycerin infusion is contraindicated and highly dangerous" due to sildenafil, naming the specific interaction the record falsely cleared.
